purpose: Re-execute the already-accepted seed-free runtime capture mechanisms on one exact source head so their outputs can be compared and later assembled under the independently accepted complete-runtime validator.
invariants: Every JSON capture that declares source_commit/source_tree must equal the composite workflow HEAD/tree.
All required outputs must be present and non-empty before artifact publication.
No official seed, ordering, allocation, claim, game initialization, action, outcome, or deck conclusion may be read or produced.
The composite is candidate provenance only; it does not adopt an expected manifest or prepared-worker authority.
Behavioral capture implementations remain byte-identical to their already-accepted versions.
next_gate: Independently audit the original composite artifact. If the single-source bindings and payloads are clean, build a candidate complete manifest from this one-head evidence and validate it with the accepted complete-runtime validator before any adoption review.
